tools.does: reads a provision by its text, context and purpose

tools.name: Doctrine of precedent
tools.does: applies the reason for an earlier decision to like cases
hypotheses: the earlier court binds the later one

tools.name: Functional method of comparative law
tools.does: compares how different systems solve the same problem
